items.question: What camera systems and lenses do you use for commercial shoots?
items.answer: We shoot primarily on RED V-Raptor 8K, ARRI ALEXA Mini LF, and Sony FX9 camera systems paired with ARRI Master Primes, Cooke Anamorphic, and Leica Cine lenses.

items.question: Are your aerial drone operators licensed for commercial filming in Bahrain?
items.answer: Yes, all our heavy-lift RED drone and custom FPV operators are fully licensed and certified by the Bahrain Civil Aviation Authority (BCAA) with full public liability insurance.

items.question: How long does post-production and DaVinci Resolve color grading take?
items.answer: Standard post-production timelines range from 5 to 14 business days depending on visual effects, sound design complexity, and color grading review rounds.

items.question: Can you manage pre-production, casting, and permits for GCC projects?
items.answer: Absolutely. We handle end-to-end pre-production including location scouting, ministry permits, actor casting, storyboard creation, and set building across Bahrain and Saudi Arabia.
